conventions.convention: External JSON keys: bare lowercase via ObjectToLowerCaseKeyJson (actors, speaking_modifiers, uuid, …). Canonical: docs/reference/json-keys.md
Protocol values (speaking modifiers): underscore-wrapped (_pain_, _pleasure_, _gagged_, _kissing_). Canonical: docs/reference/protocol-tokens.md
Punish scene files use punish_* names (not punishing_*).
Orgasm narration gate substring: " is orgasming." Canonical: docs/reference/orgasm-narration.md
Sex giving actions use setting_name no_penis; fucking uses empty setting_name.
z-* files and directories at repo root are user scratch. Never ingest, changelog, or commit.
